audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen Levels 3 and 4-5 and gave Teemo Level 6, contradicting the page's own prose ('Levels 4-5 are my worst stretch', 'Then 6 changes the lane').
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Teemo/Skill/Skill/Teemo/Gwen/Gwen/Skill and matches the prose line for line.
Teemo's spikes are Blinding Dart at 1 and Noxious Trap map control late; Gwen's are Level 6 Mist and Riftmaker against a champion with no dash.
audit.corrected: Each phase why names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Blinds autos — but not your Q-Snip' was the only interaction on the page, and Guerrilla Warfare was never mentioned.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a targeted 680-range cast on a flat 7-second cooldown, so Hallowed Mist does not merely dodge it — from outside the fog the cast is impossible. Blind stops basic attacks, which is what kills the A Thousand Cuts on-hit proc and the Skip 'n Slash on-hit, while Snip Snip! and Needlework are abilities and are unaffected. Riot on Guerrilla Warfare: 'If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving' — Gwen has no stealth reveal in her kit, so facechecking brush is uniquely bad here.
audit.corrected: Mist-denies-the-cast, the attacks-not-abilities distinction, and the brush invisibility all written in.

audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, and Move Quick is 14 — those two numbers are the whole trade clock.
audit.corrected: Both written into the cooldown block and trading rules.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Teemo contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s and it turns off your autos, so A Thousand Cuts stops proccing. Last-hit at max range and eat the poison.

edits.after: Blind stops basic attacks only — Snip Snip! and Needlework fire through it. Neither of you can commit yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Teemo must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash closes the gap, but Move Quick's passive speed kites it straight back. Coinflip skirmishes until Mist.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blinding Dart's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your worst stretch: short range against a flat 7s blind and Toxic Shot ticks, with no all-in threat yet. Farm and hold W and E.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Teemo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Mist flips it: Blinding Dart is targeted at 680, so from outside the fog it will not even cast. E in, W on top, then Needlework-slow.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blinding Dart's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — he has no dash at all, so a slowed Teemo cannot leave your mist.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Teemo carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You own the 1v1 forever, but Noxious Trap walls every choke and he splitpushes. Close it out before shrooms decide the map.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds autos — but not your Q-Snip. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart (flat 7s): blinds basic attacks only — Snip Snip! and Needlework fire straight through it. - Move Quick (14s): the sprint is not cancelled by being struck. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Teemo with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Teemo wastes Blinding Dart — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Teemo with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Blinding Dart is spent — you get a 7s window with your autos working, so commit. Bad trade: dashing in while the blind is up, which wastes Skip 'n Slash and leaves you kited by Move Quick.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Guerrilla Warfare keeps him invisible while moving through brush, and you carry no reveal — never facecheck a bush.

edits.before: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: Blinds autos — but not your Q-Snip. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
